title: Preah Reach Kret on the appointment of the civil servants of  Securities and Exchange Commission of Cambodia
text:

PREAH REACH KRET
No. NS/RKT/0708/928
We
Preahkaruna Preahbath Samdech Preah Boromneath Norodom Sihamoni Samanphoum
Cheatsasna Rakhatkhateya Khemrarothreas Puthinthreathoreamohaksat Khemreachnea
Samohopheas Kampuchekreachroathboranaksanti Sopheakmonglea Sereyvibolea
Khemarasreypireas Preah Chao Krong Kampuchea Thipdey
- Having seen the Constitution of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kret No. NS/RKT/0704/124 on 15 July 2004 on the
Appointment of the Royal Government of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. 02/NS/94 on 20 July 1994 promulgating the
Law on the Organization and Functioning of the Council of Ministers;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/0196/18 on 24 January 1996
promulgating the Law on the Establishment of the Ministry of Economy and Finance;
- Having seen the Preah Reach Kram No. NS/RKM/1007/028 on 19 October 2007
promulgating the Law on Issuance and Trading of Non-Government Securities;
- Having been informed by Samdech Akak Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime
Minister of the Kingdom of Cambodia;
Hereby ordered
Article 1.-
Appointing 4 (four) civil servants of the Securities and Exchange Commission of
Cambodia as following:
1- H.E. Dr. MING Bankosal Director General of the Securities and Exchange
Commission of Cambodia with the rank and
privilege of Secretary of State
1

2- H.E. Mr. SOU Socheat Deputy Director General of the Securities and
Exchange Commission of Cambodia with the
rank and privilege of Under Secretary of State
3- H.E. Mr. KAO Thach Deputy Director General of the Securities and
Exchange Commission of Cambodia with the
rank and privilege of Under Secretary of State
4- H.E. Dr. HUOT Pum Deputy Director General of the Securities and
Exchange Commission of Cambodia with the
rank and privilege of Under Secretary of State
Article 2.-
Samdech Akak Moha Sena Padei Techo Hun Sen, Prime Minister of the Kingdom
of Cambodia shall strictly implement this Preah Reach Kret.
Article 3.-
This Preah Reach Kret shall go into force from the date of Royal Signature.
(His Royal Signature and Seal)
Norodom Sihamoni
PRL. 0807.947
The Royal Palace, Phnom Penh, 30 July 2008
No. 888.C.L
For Copy and Distribution
Phnom Penh, 01 August 2008
Deputy Secretary General of the Royal Government
(Signature and Seal)
KHUN CHINKEN
